title.narrative: Number of people having access to sufficient and safe water for domestic use

comment.narrative: Through direct verification in the communities of Monapo District), as well as Mongicual District, the field teams identified variations in population density, household size, and water point usage patterns. As a result, the actual number of people benefiting from the rehabilitated water points was 19,764, compared to the initial target of 4,000, representing a performance above 100%.

title.narrative: Number of people reached with hygiene promotion/awareness raising activities

comment.narrative:
The project reached 22,420 people, compared to the initial target of 7,500, representing approximately 299% achievement.
As a result, the number of people reached went well beyond the initial estimate, since hygiene promotion activities are community-wide by nature and often include men, women, and children from both beneficiary and neighboring households. This inclusive approach ensured that key hygiene messages, such as safe water handling, handwashing, and waste management.

title.narrative: Number of people having access to basic, safe and dignified shelter solutions

comment.narrative: While the project initially planned to reach 3,000 people, the verified data from household registrations showed a total of 3,304 individuals. This variation is explained by the larger average household size observed in the field compared to the estimate used during planning. Many families included extended members such as grandparents, relatives, or dependents living in the same household, which naturally increased the total number of beneficiaries.

title.narrative: Number of persons reached by the implementation of specific prevention measures

comment.narrative: As a result, the number of people reached increased from the planned 7,500 to 25,670 individuals, representing a 342% achievement. This significant overachievement is mainly due to the high level of community participation, including men and boys, and the inclusive approach adopted by the project, which aimed to ensure that key protection reached every corner of the community.

title.narrative: Number of persons reached by the implementation of specific GBV prevention measures

comment.narrative: As a result, the number of people reached increased from the planned 7,500 to 8,134 individuals, representing a 108% achievement. This overachievement reflects the strong interest and participation of community members, as well as the project’s inclusive and participatory approach that encouraged open dialogue about GBV prevention, protection, and available response services, including Linha Verde 1458.

title.narrative: Number of crisis-affected people who are also involved in the design, implementation, monitoring and/or evaluation of the programme

comment.narrative:
The target for this indicator was 100 people, but the project successfully reached 300 participants, representing 300% achievement.
This overachievement is mainly due to the high level of community engagement and interest observed during the assembly of Emergency Shelter Kits. Households expressed willingness to participate directly in the construction process, both to accelerate shelter completion and to learn practical techniques for future maintenance or replication.

title.narrative: Number of adaptations in the design and/or implementation of the JR, as a result of the input from beneficiaries

comment.narrative: Following the Rapid Real-Time Review (RRTR), several adjustments were made to ensure that the assistance provided aligns more closely with the needs and expectations of the affected communities. Specifically, we revised the implementation plan to ensure that beneficiaries are supported within the project’s operational timeline, addressing identified delays and optimizing resource allocation.

In addition, based on feedback from the Monapo District Government, (2) the project team included local enumerators in the beneficiary registration process. This adjustment not only strengthened local engagement but also enhanced data accuracy and community ownership throughout the registration and implementation phases.
